observation: Required CPU operations and frozen source snapshot validation passed.
rationale: The local CPU numerical stack and source identity passed the G0 smoke checks.

observation: Operational variants require unambiguous identities in method records.
decision: Retain B00-B11 family IDs and serialize B08:gd, B08:ridge, B09:least_squares, B09:ridge, B10:posterior, B10:empirical_bayes, and B05:<target_id> as distinct method IDs. Software estimator initialization norm and trainable parameter count are not applicable.

observation: Task 5 exposes a single frontier point; plotting requires raw sampled frontier data.
decision: Task 6 supplies optional deterministic cached width/norm-cap grids with midpoint refinement, both branch diagnostics and resources, and raw JSON/CSV in fresh attempt directories. Midpoint interpolation errors and switch brackets are float diagnostics, not rigorous enclosures; unresolved numerical intervals remain explicit. Exact primary rational certificates remain scoped to the verified fixture.

observation: Analytic conditional risk requires the target context size and its Gaussian input-law assumption; the original three-field population truth omitted these evaluator inputs.
decision: Add required keyword-only target_context_size and input_law='gaussian_isotropic' to evaluator-only PopulationTruth; reject unsupported input laws. The target context size is never inferred from source block size. This completes the interface without changing the scientific population.

observation: SourceTask keys are opaque and do not encode an accessible phase; provenance must be checked without exposing generator or evaluator truth.
decision: The trusted runner declares a source_access_manifest with disjoint training_keys and validation_keys before passing observations to learned methods. Selection and fit_meta reject missing, duplicate, overlapping, undeclared or role-mismatched keys and repeated observation blocks; methods never derive authorization from their incoming data. The manifest is public observation-access metadata and excludes protected keys and population truth.

observation: Fresh data roots previously also changed the Gaussian population rotation; input-law spelling differed between configuration and evaluator interfaces.
decision: Resolve workload.population_seed once from the exploratory root when absent, freeze its actual population/covariance/rotation asset hashes, and keep it independent of protected observation roots. Canonicalize gaussian_isotropic; accept isotropic_gaussian as an explicit semantic-preserving legacy configuration alias. Historical evidence remains bound to its original revision.

observation: Pilot and confirmation require identical source fitting, validation selection, frozen initialization and task execution.
decision: Allocate shared scientific execution to execution.py and retain pilot compatibility wrappers. runner.py remains durable block storage. Confirmation commits each complete replication with every candidate/family, paired roles, immutable arrays, separate task phases and literal/direct arithmetic diagnostics; interrupted uncommitted replications replay under the same identity.

observation: Endpoint counts and moment assumptions differ across deterministic, conditional-preparation, fixed-task and nested-task modes.
decision: Deterministic mode has no stochastic counts or CI obligation. Fixed and nested simulation mean intervals require structural per-estimator loss-second-moment eligibility and real independent calibration at the frozen independent count; nested evidence also supplies measured between/within components, costs and resolved source/tuning evidence. Preserve zero-penalty controls. Unsupported modes may freeze explicitly descriptive schedules with no CI or superiority claim; descriptive nested schedules retain unresolved source accuracy/tuning as explicit limitations. Primary operational secondary simulations are separately scheduled descriptive contrasts; comparative calibrated operational inference uses a separately frozen fixed/nested endpoint.

observation: Publishing protocol/confirmation.json after a clean implementation commit creates an untracked scientific input; committing that file would change the frozen implementation revision.
decision: Confirmation accepts only the explicit input manifest path as an untracked-file exception, only after full content validation and exact equality to its immutable in-memory snapshot. Enumerate untracked files individually with NUL delimiters; refuse every tracked diff and every other untracked file. Code, Git revision, dependency lock, installed runtime/build/thread controls, scientific and prior/population hashes remain strict. Record the canonical input manifest hash. A later evidence commit is never relabelled as the executed source revision.

observation: Task 11 implementation is verified with tiny temporary real execution fixtures and deliberately labelled driver fault injections.
decision: These tests supply no production G6/G7 result. Complete implementation/dependency commits first, then regenerate genuinely calibrated pilot evidence on that revision before freezing any production protected schedule. Historical falsely resolved tuning artifacts cannot authorize a new freeze.
